title: What If All the Grass on Earth Vanished?

scenes.text: What if every blade of grass on Earth vanished? Your lawn would be the least of it.
The grass family feeds the world. More than half of all calories people eat come from grasses.
Rice, maize and wheat alone supply about two thirds of humanity's food calories. All three are grasses.
Cattle and sheep that graze on pasture would lose their main food.
Barley, oats, sorghum and sugarcane are grasses too. Bread, beer and sugar would go with them.
Without grass, the world's dinner table would be almost empty.
